title: Three thousand men and a lot of blasting powder
text: The loop in the track here was cut through solid and decomposed granite by about 3,000 Chinese workers between 1875 and 1876. They had little more than hand tools, picks, shovels, horse-drawn carts and blasting powder. The line over the mountains originally needed 18 tunnels and ten bridges, and the whole thing was finished in under two years, under the Southern Pacific engineer William Hood.

s3.title: California Historical Landmarks in Kern County
s3.quote: No. 508 Tehachapi Loop: From this spot may be seen a portion of the world-renowned Loop completed in 1876 under the direction of William Hood, Southern Pacific railroad engineer.
